_note: 學習路徑內容建置・虛擬語氣：If only ... 的虛擬願望（eng.t_sub.subj.if-only，學測／分科級）。對現在的願望＝If only ＋ 過去式（be 動詞用 were）；對過去的遺憾＝If only ＋ 過去完成式(had p.p.)；對未來的渴望／抱怨＝If only ＋ 主詞 ＋ would ＋ 原形。語氣比 wish 更強烈。高階防第二正解：對過去用過去完成式、對現在用過去式，不混用。皆標準英語，形式依 Cambridge / Oxford；claim 標 provisional、待英語母語 reviewer 複核。文法單元無音檔。

units.can_do: 我能用 If only 表達強烈的願望或遺憾：對現在用過去式（be 用 were）、對過去用過去完成式、對未來的渴望或抱怨用 If only ＋ 主詞 ＋ would ＋ 原形。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: For a strong wish about the PRESENT, use 'If only + past simple' (and 'were' for be, all persons): If only I knew the answer. / If only I were taller.
claims.verification_ref: 對現在的願望＝If only ＋ 過去式（be 用 were）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: For a regret about the PAST, use 'If only + past perfect (had + past participle)': If only I had studied harder.
claims.verification_ref: 對過去的遺憾＝If only ＋ 過去完成式；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: For a strong desire or complaint about the FUTURE (often about someone else's behaviour), use 'If only + subject + would + base form': If only it would stop raining.
claims.verification_ref: 對未來的渴望／抱怨＝If only ＋ 主詞 ＋ would ＋ 原形；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'If only' has the same grammar as 'I wish' but expresses stronger emotion: If only I hadn't said that!
claims.verification_ref: If only 文法同 wish 但語氣更強烈；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: 'If only' expresses a strong wish or regret. It uses the same tenses as 'I wish', but the feeling is stronger. For a wish about the PRESENT, use the past simple, and use 'were' for the verb 'be': 'If only I knew her name.' / 'If only I were taller.'
teach.zh_hint: If only 表達強烈的願望或遺憾，用的時態和 I wish 一樣，但情感更強。對「現在」的願望用過去式，be 動詞用 were：If only I knew her name。／If only I were taller。

teach.body: If only I lived nearer the library.
teach.zh_hint: 要是我住得離圖書館近一點就好了。對現在的願望→過去式 lived（live 的過去式，形式和下面過去完成式的 had 明顯不同）。

teach.body: For a regret about the PAST, use the past perfect (had + past participle): 'If only I had studied harder.' For a strong desire or complaint about the FUTURE, often about someone else, use 'If only + subject + would + base form': 'If only he would listen to me.'
teach.zh_hint: 對「過去」的遺憾用過去完成式(had ＋ 過去分詞)：If only I had studied harder。對「未來」的渴望或抱怨（常針對別人）用 If only ＋ 主詞 ＋ would ＋ 原形：If only he would listen to me。

teach.body: If only I had not missed the last train home.
teach.zh_hint: 要是我沒錯過最後一班回家的火車就好了。對過去的遺憾→過去完成式 had not missed。

practice.stem: 填入正確的形式（對現在的願望）：If only I ____ how to swim; then I could join you.（要是我會游泳就好了，那我就能跟你們一起了）

distractor_rationales.know: 對現在的願望用過去式 knew（虛擬），不是現在式 know。
distractor_rationales.had known: had known 是過去完成式，用於對『過去』的遺憾；此處是現在的願望，用 knew。
distractor_rationales.would know: If only 的子句不用 would know 表達現在願望；對現在用過去式 knew。

practice.feedback: 對現在的願望用過去式：If only I knew how to swim。

practice.stem: 填入正確的形式（對現在的願望，be 動詞）：If only I ____ a little taller, I could reach the top shelf.（要是我再高一點就好了，就搆得到最上層了）

distractor_rationales.am: If only 對現在的願望，be 動詞各人稱都用 were，不用現在式 am。
distractor_rationales.had been: had been 是過去完成式，用於對過去的遺憾；此處是現在的願望，用 were。
distractor_rationales.would be: 對現在的願望用 were，不用 would be。

practice.feedback: 對現在的願望，be 動詞用 were：If only I were a little taller。

practice.stem: 填入正確的形式（對過去的遺憾）：If only I ____ to her advice, I wouldn't be in this mess.（要是我當初有聽她的建議就好了）

distractor_rationales.listened: 對『過去』的遺憾用過去完成式 had listened；過去式 listened 表達對現在的願望。
distractor_rationales.listen: 原形 listen 不能表達這裡的過去遺憾；用 had listened。
distractor_rationales.would listen: would listen 用於對未來的渴望／抱怨；對過去的遺憾用 had listened。

practice.feedback: 對過去的遺憾用過去完成式：If only I had listened to her advice。

practice.stem: 填入正確的形式（對未來的渴望／抱怨，想改變某個狀況）：If only it ____ stop raining so we could go out!（要是雨能停下來就好了，我們就能出門了）

distractor_rationales.had: had stop 不合語法；對未來的渴望用 If only ＋ would ＋ 原形(would stop)。
distractor_rationales.will: If only 的子句不用 will；用 would ＋ 原形。
distractor_rationales.were to: were to 用於假設條件句 if 子句，不是 If only 表達對未來渴望的句型；用 would stop。

practice.feedback: 對未來的渴望／抱怨用 If only ＋ would ＋ 原形：If only it would stop raining。

practice.stem: 用 If only 改寫（對過去的遺憾）：'I am sad because I did not say goodbye to him.' → 'If only I ____ goodbye to him.'
practice.answer: If only I had said goodbye to him.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：對過去的遺憾用過去完成式：If only I had said goodbye to him。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 純文字朗讀＋語調模仿（無音檔，自己朗讀→自評）：only 重讀以傳達強烈情感；過去完成式(had p.p.)連讀但清楚，句尾可帶嘆息語氣。

lines.text: If only I knew what to do right now.
lines.intonation: only 重讀、knew 稍長、句尾帶渴望語氣

lines.text: If only I had taken that chance when I had it.
lines.intonation: had taken 連讀、句尾下收帶遺憾
